title: Delete 10 dead private methods from ChatServices.cs
description:
P1: 10 confirmed-dead private methods (~230 lines) in `ChatServices.cs`, each an orphaned pre-decomposition implementation with a live, separately-maintained duplicate now doing the real work in `ChatToolCatalog.cs`/`ChatContextPlanner.cs`. Also 6 private `[GeneratedRegex]` fields (`ExactReplyRegex`, `SimpleNoContextRegex`, `LocalKnowledgeRegex`, `AgentWriteCommandRegex`, `EvidenceSeekingRegex`, `AgentContextRegex`) that are byte-for-byte identical to copies in `ChatContextPlanner.cs`.

Dead methods: `ShouldPreloadContext`, `FormatRecordAsync`, `ReadLexicalQuery`, `ReadSemanticQuery`, `ReadHybridQuery`, `ReadContextPackQuery`, `FormatLexicalResults`, `FormatSemanticResults`, `FormatHybridResults`, `FormatContextPack`.

Scope:
- Delete all 10 methods and 6 regex fields from `ChatServices.cs`
- Verify with `dotnet build` and full test pass
- This is a Step 1.5 for TSK-0042 — delete superseded members before the full file split

Evidence: MemorySmith-Audit-Delta-2-20260702.md §1, council/audit-synthesis-council-20260705.md

comments.author: AgentSmith
